title: Citizen Archivist Program
organization: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration (NARA)
description: A 100% online volunteer program transcribing, tagging, and reviewing historical U.S. government records in the National Archives Catalog. No office visit or application fee, and the program's own FAQ states plainly it is 'open to anyone in the world,' noting that international volunteers use Back Up codes for login.gov authentication rather than a US-specific verification method. No minimum age is stated for this online program specifically -- a separate, unrelated in-person NARA volunteer role requires age 16+, per the same source ecosystem, but that requirement is not carried over here since it applies to a different, physical program.
application_requirements: Free login.gov account (international users authenticate via Back Up codes)
current_cycle_label: Ongoing -- no assignments or deadlines, volunteers contribute at their own pace
verification_status: Verified - official FAQ page fetched and read ('This is a volunteer, 100% online project'; 'Yes! The program is open to anyone in the world'). Minimum age not stated for this specific online program -- left null rather than borrowing the 16+ figure from NARA's unrelated in-person volunteering role.

title: DoSomething.org
description: A youth-led nonprofit platform where members join rolling online and offline social-action campaigns on issues including racism, gender inclusivity, food insecurity, and STEM access. The organization's own About page states its members are 'ages 13-25.' Independent secondary sources consistently describe more than 2 million members across the US and 131 other countries; no membership fee or payment language was found anywhere on the pages checked.
cost: No membership fee or payment language found on any page checked
current_cycle_label: Ongoing -- rolling campaigns, join any time
verification_status: Verified - official About page fetched and read ('ages 13-25'); the '131 countries' figure and the absence of a membership fee are corroborated by consistent WebSearch synthesis (Wikipedia, GivingCompass) rather than an explicit quote from the same primary page -- flagged rather than asserted as independently confirmed

title: Youth Journalism International
description: A global journalism organization connecting teen writers, artists, and photographers with professional editing mentorship and cross-cultural newsroom experience, with eligibility for the organization's annual journalism contest. Independent secondary sources consistently and specifically quote its own eligibility rule as open to anyone '19 or younger,' with no cost to join, and describe members across six continents. The organization's own domain could not be reached directly during this research pass -- every attempt returned a connection failure rather than a content block.
cost: Free, per corroborating secondary sources; not independently confirmed on the organization's own domain
current_cycle_label: Ongoing -- rolling membership, apply any time
verification_status: Corroborated via WebSearch synthesis after multiple direct fetch attempts on youthjournalism.org returned connection failures rather than content; the '19 or younger' age rule and 'no cost to join' language read as direct quotes from the organization's own Join page as surfaced through search, not an independent single-source primary read

title: Smithsonian Digital Volunteers: Transcription Center
description: A free digital-volunteer program transcribing historical and scientific documents from Smithsonian collections, open to anonymous browsing/transcribing by anyone, with a registered-user tier for volunteers who are, per the organization's own stated policy, 14 years of age or older. No country restriction was found in the sources checked, though this was not independently confirmed on the Smithsonian's own domain, which returned a connection block (403) on every direct attempt during this research pass.
current_cycle_label: Ongoing -- no minimum time commitment, contribute at own pace
verification_status: Corroborated via WebSearch synthesis after every direct fetch of transcription.si.edu and si.edu returned HTTP 403; the 'at least 14 years or older' age rule reads as a direct quote from the organization's own FAQ as surfaced through search, not an independent single-source primary read
